title: gouldia antiqua var. oblonga
intro: Gouldia antiqua var. oblonga, commonly known as the Hawaiian sandalwood, is a rare and endangered species of plant native to the Hawaiian Islands. It is valued for its aromatic wood and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawaiian sandalwood include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, including santalol and santalene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
